name: fix87_cursor
verifies: fix-87: the pointer only where it can be used (CursorPolicy): hidden while a dialog line is spoken, shown with the choice list, gone in play; using a chest it stays hidden through the approach walk and the opening until the loot page opens, then shows; closing the page hides it again
notes: cursorseen lists the CursorPolicy modes frame by frame since cursorwatch. The dialog waits for the line(s) before the choice list (the runner does not skip them, so the hidden phase is seen). cursorvisible/cursorlocked read Unity's state; in the editor the lock itself needs the focused Game view, the policy mode (cursor) does not.
